newsitem.title: UK: UK shares seen mixed-to-lower after Dow plunge.
newsitem.headline: UK shares seen mixed-to-lower after Dow plunge.

text.p: UK shares were seen opening mixed-to-lower on Monday, continuing their retreat from Friday's early record high after Wall Street extended its losses following the London market close, dealers said.
"We will probably be mixed-to-down at the starts, I get the feeling people would like to see the market a bit lower," said one dealer.

Market attention later in the day was seen focused on a French budget statement, which could have a significant impact on European currencies and interest rates in the run-up to European monetary union.
